title: kith-tui: bearer token auth via KITH_TOKEN
description: kith-tui sends no Authorization header (kithd authenticates via Tailscale). To use kith-tui against chinwag (IIW demo, Tue 2026-11-03), send RFC 6750 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' on session, API and SSE requests when KITH_TOKEN is set. Read from env, not argv, so the token stays out of shell history and ps.
close_reason: KITH_TOKEN bearer auth on all requests; 4 tests
